title: Designing a Satellite Serviced Quantum Network Backbone for Concurrent Global Connectivity
summary: Satellite-serviced quantum networks pose an architectural problem distinct from classical satellite networking: because entanglement cannot be copied, and long-lived buffering is technologically constrained for near-term devices, useful end-to-end service requires fixed optical ground infrastructure and simultaneous multi-hop path availability. We investigate the design of a satellite-serviced quantum backbone aimed at supporting concurrent global connectivity across a traffic matrix of major population and financial centers under finite waiting-time constraints.
